description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) percentages of different editing methods applied to BioGPT and Llama2, with the x-axis representing the co-occurrence number and the y-axis representing the accuracy percentage. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and has a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and ranges from 60% to 80%. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different editing method: Base (black line with circle markers), MEND (brown line with diamond markers), FT (blue line with triangle markers), MEMIT (purple line with pentagon markers), IKE (red line with triangle markers), and ROME (green line with square markers). The Base line starts at approximately 65% accuracy at the lowest co-occurrence number and ends at around 70% at the highest co-occurrence number. The MEND line starts at around 68% and ends at about 75%. The FT line starts at approximately 67% and ends at around 73%. The MEMIT line starts at about 69% and ends at roughly 74%. The IKE line starts at around 66% and ends at about 72%. The ROME line starts at approximately 70% and ends at around 78%. The plot shows that the ROME method has the highest accuracy across all co-occurrence numbers, while the Base method has the lowest.
